name: Web Browsing Agent
description: Agents that can access web pages, extract content, and perform actions
description_zh: 让 Agent 能够访问网页、提取内容、执行操作

combinations.name: Basic
combinations.description: Static page content extraction - simplest setup
combinations.description_zh: 静态页面内容提取 - 最简单的配置

combinations.name: Advanced
combinations.description_zh: 动态页面 + 整站爬取

quick_start:
import requests

# Using Jina Reader to fetch page content
url = "https://example.com"
markdown = requests.get(f"https://r.jina.ai/{url}").text
print(markdown)

name: Persistent Memory Agent
description: Agents that remember user preferences, history, and context across sessions
description_zh: 让 Agent 跨会话记住用户偏好、历史决策和上下文

tools.use_case_zh: 自编辑记忆、有状态 Agent

combinations.name: Simple Memory
combinations.description_zh: 三行代码集成，用户偏好

combinations.name: Context-Aware
combinations.description_zh: 知识图谱，200ms 返回上下文

combinations.name: Stateful Agent
combinations.description_zh: Agent 拥有可自我编辑的记忆块

quick_start:
from mem0 import Memory

m = Memory()

# Store a memory
m.add("User likes dark mode", user_id="user_123")

# Retrieve relevant memories
memories = m.search("user preferences", user_id="user_123")

combinations.name: Cloud Deployment
combinations.description: Deploy agent as scalable cloud function
combinations.description_zh: 将 Agent 部署为可扩展云函数

combinations.name: Dev Environment
combinations.description_zh: 完整的 IDE 级环境

quick_start:
from e2b import Sandbox

# Create a secure sandbox
sbx = Sandbox()

# Run Python code
execution = sbx.run_code("print('Hello from Agent!')")
print(execution.stdout)  # Hello from Agent!

sbx.close()

name: Email Agent
description: Agents that can send and receive emails autonomously
description_zh: 让 Agent 能够自主收发邮件

tools.use_case_zh: Agent 专用邮箱，API 优先

combinations.name: Native Email
combinations.description: Agent gets its own email address
combinations.description_zh: Agent 获得专属邮箱地址

quick_start:
import requests

# Send email via AgentMail
response = requests.post(
    "https://api.agentmail.to/v1/send",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_KEY"},
    json={
        "to": "user@example.com",
        "subject": "Hello from Agent",
        "body": "This is an automated message."
    }
)

name: Multi-Agent Collaboration
description: Multiple agents working together with defined roles and workflows
description_zh: 多个 Agent 协同工作，有明确角色和流程

tools.use_case_zh: 基于角色的多 Agent 团队
可视化多 Agent 构建器

combinations.name: Role-Based Team
combinations.description_zh: 研究员、作者、审核员 Agent

combinations.name: Conversation-Based
combinations.description: Agents negotiate and solve problems together
combinations.description_zh: Agent 互相协商解决问题

quick_start:
from crewai import Agent, Task, Crew

researcher = Agent(role='Researcher', goal='Find information')
writer = Agent(role='Writer', goal='Write content')

task = Task(description='Write about AI agents', agent=writer)
crew = Crew(agents=[researcher, writer], tasks=[task])
result = crew.kickoff()
